quranTranslation.text: Hast thou not observed those who were forbidden conspiracy and afterward returned to that which they had been forbidden, and (now) conspire together for crime and wrongdoing and disobedience toward the messenger? And when they come unto thee they greet thee with a greeting wherewith Allah greeteth thee not, and say within themselves: Why should Allah punish us for what we say? Hell will suffice them; they will feel the heat thereof - a hapless journey's end!

explanation.bs: „I govore u sebi“ – قَالَ za ono što ostaje u duši.
explanation.en: “And say within themselves” — قَالَ for what stays in the soul.

quranTranslation.text: Say: He is Allah, the One!

explanation.bs: „Reci: On – Allah je Jedan“ – قُلْ uvodi sadržaj koji treba prenijeti.
explanation.en: “Say: He is Allah, the One!” — قُلْ introduces the content to be conveyed.

quranTranslation.text: And messengers We have mentioned unto thee before and messengers We have not mentioned unto thee; and Allah spake directly unto Moses;

explanation.bs: „A s Musaom je Allah uistinu govorio“ – obraćanje Musau, naglašeno imenicom تَكْلِيمًا.
explanation.en: “And Allah spake directly unto Moses” — the address to Moses, stressed by the verbal noun تَكْلِيمًا.

quranTranslation.text: Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?

explanation.bs: „Kako ćemo razgovarati s djetetom koje leži u kolijevci?“ – كَلَّمَ za razgovor sa sagovornikom.
explanation.en: “How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?” — كَلَّمَ for speaking with someone.

quranTranslation.text: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak.

explanation.bs: „Pa pitajte njih, ako umiju govoriti!“ – Ibrahim pokazuje da idoli nemaju moć govora.
explanation.en: “So question them, if they can speak” — Abraham shows the idols have no power of speech.

quranTranslation.text: This is a day wherein they speak not,

explanation.bs: „Ovo je dan u kojem oni ne govore“ – govor uskraćen.
explanation.en: “This is a day wherein they speak not” — speech withheld.

quranTranslation.text: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.

explanation.bs: „I on ne govori po svojoj želji“ – čin govora Poslanika.
explanation.en: “Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire” — the act of the Prophet's speech.

quranTranslation.text: That ye grieve not for the sake of that which hath escaped you, nor yet exult because of that which hath been given. Allah loveth not all prideful boasters,

explanation.bs: „i da se zbog onoga što vam je dao ne radujete“ – pokuđena radost.
explanation.en: “Nor yet exult because of that which hath been given” — joy that is blamed.

quranTranslation.text: Say: In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy: therein let them rejoice. It is better than what they hoard.

explanation.bs: „Allahovom dobrotom i Njegovom milošću – time neka se raduju“ – dopuštena radost.
explanation.en: “In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy: therein let them rejoice” — joy that is allowed.

quranTranslation.text: Allah enlargeth livelihood for whom He will, and straiteneth (it for whom He will); and they rejoice in the life of the world, whereas the life of the world is but brief comfort as compared with the Hereafter.

explanation.bs: A oni se raduju životu na ovom svijetu – radost prolaznom.
explanation.en: And they rejoice in the worldly life — joy in what passes.

quranTranslation.text: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;

explanation.bs: Allah će im dati sjaj na licima i radost – nagrada pravednicima.
explanation.en: Allah will give them radiance and happiness — the reward of the righteous.

quranTranslation.text: And will return unto his folk in joy.

explanation.bs: Radostan će se vratiti svojima – onaj kome je knjiga data u desnu ruku.
explanation.en: He will return to his people in happiness — the one given his record in his right hand.

quranTranslation.text: He verily lived joyous with his folk,

explanation.bs: Jer je on među svojima bio radostan – tefsir: ovosvjetska radost bez misli o Ahiretu, suprotno 84:9.
explanation.en: Indeed he had been among his people in happiness — tafsir: worldly joy without thought of the Hereafter, set against 84:9.

quranTranslation.text: See they not how many a generation We destroyed before them, whom We had established in the earth more firmly than We have established you, and We shed on them abundant showers from the sky, and made the rivers flow beneath them. Yet we destroyed them for their sins, and created after them another generation.

explanation.bs: „Zar ne vide koliko smo pokoljenja prije njih uništili?“
explanation.en: “See they not how many a generation We destroyed before them?”

gloss.en: to destroy, to cause to perish

quranTranslation.text: And when he turneth away (from thee) his effort in the land is to make mischief therein and to destroy the crops and the cattle; and Allah loveth not mischief.

explanation.bs: Kad se okrene (ili: kad dođe na vlast – tefsir se razilazi), nastoji da uništi usjeve i porod – čovjek kao uzrok propasti.
explanation.en: When he turns away (or: gains authority — tafsir differs), he strives to destroy crops and offspring — a man as the cause of ruin.

gloss.en: to destroy, to cause to perish

quranTranslation.text: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:

explanation.bs: „Uništio sam silan imetak“ – أَهْلَكَ i za rasipanje imetka.
explanation.en: “I have destroyed vast wealth” — أَهْلَكَ also of squandering wealth.

gloss.en: to destroy, to cause to perish

quranTranslation.text: And when We would destroy a township We send commandment to its folk who live at ease, and afterward they commit abomination therein, and so the Word (of doom) hath effect for it, and we annihilate it with complete annihilation.

explanation.bs: Kad hoćemo da uništimo (نُهْلِكَ) neki grad… pa ga potpuno zatremo (دَمَّرْنَاهَا تَدْمِيرًا) – oba glagola, drugi kao vrhunac.
explanation.en: When We intend to destroy (نُهْلِكَ) a city… and We destroy it with complete destruction (دَمَّرْنَاهَا تَدْمِيرًا) — both verbs, the second as the climax.

quranTranslation.text: And We caused the folk who were despised to inherit the eastern parts of the land and the western parts thereof which We had blessed. And the fair word of thy Lord was fulfilled for the Children of Israel because of their endurance; and We annihilated (all) that Pharaoh and his folk had done and that they had contrived.

explanation.bs: „I razorili smo sve što su gradili faraon i njegov narod“ – zatiranje djela.
explanation.en: “We annihilated (all) that Pharaoh and his folk had done” — wiping out works.

quranTranslation.text: Destroying all things by commandment of its Lord. And morning found them so that naught could be seen save their dwellings. Thus do We reward the guilty folk.

explanation.bs: Vjetar „koji sve razara po naredbi svoga Gospodara“ – jedini subjekt koji nije Allah, a i on po Njegovoj naredbi.
explanation.en: A wind “destroying all things by commandment of its Lord” — the one subject other than Allah, and that by His command.

quranTranslation.text: Muhammad is but a messenger, messengers (the like of whom) have passed away before him. Will it be that, when he dieth or is slain, ye will turn back on your heels? He who turneth back on his heels doth no hurt to Allah, and Allah will reward the thankful.

explanation.bs: „Pa ako on umre ili bude ubijen…“ – ar-Rāġib: smrt kao gubitak života, ubistvo kao nečije djelo.
explanation.en: “Will it be that, when he dieth or is slain…” — ar-Rāġib: death as loss of life, killing as someone's act.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Kill no wild game while ye are on the pilgrimage. Whoso of you killeth it of set purpose he shall pay its forfeit in the equivalent of that which he hath killed, of domestic animals, the judge to be two men among you known for justice, (the forfeit) to be brought as an offering to the Ka'bah; or, for expiation, he shall feed poor persons, or the equivalent thereof in fasting, that he may taste the evil consequences of his deed. Allah forgiveth whatever (of this kind) may have happened in the past, but whoso relapseth, Allah will take retribution from him. Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).

explanation.bs: „Ne ubijajte lovinu dok ste u ihramu“ – ar-Rāġib: rečeno je قَتْل, a ne ‚klanje‘, jer je opće – zabranjen je svaki način.
explanation.en: “Kill no wild game while ye are on the pilgrimage” — ar-Rāġib: قَتْل, not slaughter, because it is general — every way is forbidden.

quranTranslation.text: For that cause We decreed for the Children of Israel that whosoever killeth a human being for other than manslaughter or corruption in the earth, it shall be as if he had killed all mankind, and whoso saveth the life of one, it shall be as if he had saved the life of all mankind. Our messengers came unto them of old with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but afterwards lo! many of them became prodigals in the earth.

explanation.bs: „Ko ubije dušu, a ne zbog ubijene duše … kao da je ubio sve ljude.“
explanation.en: “Whosoever killeth a human being for other than manslaughter … it shall be as if he had killed all mankind.”

quranTranslation.text: And when Moses said unto his people: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye sacrifice a cow, they said: Dost thou make game of us? He answered: Allah forbid that I should be among the foolish!

explanation.bs: „Allah vam doista naređuje da zakoljete jednu kravu“ – klanje životinje.
explanation.en: “Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye sacrifice a cow” — slaughtering an animal.

quranTranslation.text: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.

explanation.bs: „Sine moj, ja u snu vidim da te koljem“ – Ibrahimov san; sin je otkupljen (37:107).
explanation.en: “O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee” — Abraham's dream; the son was ransomed (37:107).

quranTranslation.text: I verily will punish him with hard punishment or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse.

explanation.bs: Sulejman o pupavcu: „…ili ću ga sigurno zaklati, osim ako mi ne donese jasan dokaz“ – klanje kao kazna.
explanation.en: Solomon of the hoopoe: “…or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse” — slaughter as a penalty.
